$comment: Other names the same author is catalogued under. The upstream index picks one name per author and drops the rest, which hides a writer from anyone searching the name they actually know — Mar Jacob is Jacob of Serugh, Caius is Gaius. Shown as 別名 beside the English name; nothing here affects slugs, sorting or grouping. Mathetes is the odd one: the word is not a name at all, but the index needs something to file the Epistle to Diognetus under, so the entry stands and the alias says what it really is.
